47100.commentary: (ANa) ass'ājānīye'ti kāraṇ'ākāraṇaṃ jānanake asse. puris'ājānīyesu'pi es'eva nayo. imasmiṃ sutte arahattaphalaṃ kathitaṃ. tatr'āyaṃ arahattamaggena ñāṇajavasampanno'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, sandha, bhadro puris'ājānīyo araññagato'pi rukkhamūlagato'pi suññ'āgāragato'pi na kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti

examples.text: katame pañca? itthī, bhikkhave, puris'ādhippāyā appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati. puriso, bhikkhave, itth'ādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati.

idaṃ pure cittam'acāri cārikaṃ, yen'icchakaṃ yatthakāmaṃ yathāsukhaṃ, tadajj'ahaṃ niggahessāmi yoniso, hatthippabhinnaṃ viya aṅkusaggaho.
migaluddo pure āsiṃ, araññe kānane ahaṃ, disvāna taṃ devadevaṃ, tiṇamuṭṭhiṃ adās'ahaṃ.
icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā, pacchā pure vā'pi apekkhamānā, ime'va kāme purime'va jappaṃ.
yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure, yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho.

47114.meaning1: prefers; has a preference; puts forward

asantaṃ bhāvanam'iccheyya, purekkhārañ'ca bhikkhusu, āvāsesu ca issariyaṃ, pūjā parakulesu ca.

hirī tassa apālambo, saty'assa parivāraṇaṃ, dhamm'āhaṃ sārathiṃ brūmi, sammādiṭṭhipurejavaṃ.

47120.meaning1: before any one else; very first of all
47120.meaning2: before any one else, most early

47123.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of purebhatta

47124.meaning1: what should have been said before; what should have been spoken first

47125.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, from pura

atha kho, bhikkhave, rājā purohitena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ yena so ambo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā mantaṃ pariyāpuṇāti.

47127.meaning2: son of the chief priest; royal adviser's son

47129.commentary: (VINa) pulakaṃ nāma nitthusaṃ katvā ussedetvā gahitayavataṇḍulā vuccanti.

ekacce antonadiyaṃ vālukāpuline nipajjiṃsu, ekacce bahithale, antonipannesu'pi pubbe akatapāpakammā atthi, bahinipannesu'pi pubbe katapāpakammā atthi, tesaṃ nipannaṭṭhānesu kipillikā uṭṭhahiṃsu.

47135.meaning1: due to having a masculine gender; in the masculine gender

47136.commentary: (SNPa) puḷav'āvasathe'ti puḷavānaṃ āvāse. ayam'pi lohakumbhī'y'eva devadūte gūthanirayo'ti vuttā, tattha patitassa sūcimukhapāṇā chavi-ādīni chinditvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ khādanti.

examples.text: puḷav'āvasathe salilasmiṃ, tattha kiṃ paccati kibbisakārī, gantuṃ na hi tīram'ap'atthi, sabbasamā hi samantakapallā.

47137.meaning1: (of a corpse) worm infested; maggot eaten
47137.commentary: (SNa) puḷavakasaññā'ti puḷavaṃ puḷavan'ti bhāventassa uppannasaññā. (PMa) puḷavā vuccanti kimayo, puḷave kiratī'ti puḷavakaṃ. kimiparipuṇṇassa chavasarīrass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: aniccasaññaṃ bhāveti… anattasaññaṃ bhāveti… maraṇasaññaṃ bhāveti… āhāre paṭikūlasaññaṃ bhāveti… sabbaloke anabhiratisaññaṃ bhāveti… aṭṭhikasaññaṃ bhāveti… puḷavakasaññaṃ bhāveti… vinīlakasaññaṃ bhāveti… vicchiddakasaññaṃ bhāveti… uddhumātakasaññaṃ bhāveti….

katamañ'c'āvuso, anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhadrakaṃ samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati, aṭṭhikasaññaṃ, puḷavakasaññaṃ, vinīlakasaññaṃ, vicchiddakasaññaṃ, uddhumātakasaññaṃ. idaṃ vuccat'āvuso, anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ.

47140.meaning1: (os a corpse) worm infested; maggot ridden

examples.text: aniccasaññaṃ bhāveti… anattasaññaṃ bhāveti… maraṇasaññaṃ bhāveti… āhāre paṭikūlasaññaṃ bhāveti… sabbaloke anabhiratisaññaṃ bhāveti… aṭṭhikasaññaṃ bhāveti… puḷuvakasaññaṃ bhāveti… vinīlakasaññaṃ bhāveti… vicchiddakasaññaṃ bhāveti… uddhumātakasaññaṃ bhāveti….

47141.meaning1: perception of a worm infested corpse

examples.text: katamañ'c'āvuso, anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhadrakaṃ samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati, aṭṭhikasaññaṃ, puḷuvakasaññaṃ, vinīlakasaññaṃ, vicchiddakasaññaṃ, uddhumātakasaññaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho
pūgena paṭisaṃvidite, yo tasmiṃ pūge manusso khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā āharati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma.
tiṭṭhe ce so tattha anānuyāyī, pūgam'pi vassānaṃ samantacakkhu, tatth'eva so sītisiyā vimutto, cavetha viññāṇaṃ tathāvidhassa.

yassa kassaci, mahānāma, kulaputtassa pañca dhammā saṃvijjanti, yadi vā rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa, yadi vā raṭṭhikassa pettanikassa, yadi vā senāya senāpatikassa, yadi vā gāmagāmaṇikassa, yadi vā pūgagāmaṇikassa, ye vā pana kulesu paccek'ādhipaccaṃ kārenti, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā, raṭṭhiko … pettaṇiko… senāpatiko… gāmagāmaṇiko … pūgagāmaṇiko yāva'd'atthaṃ seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharanto yāvajīvaṃ pūgagāmaṇikattaṃ kārento pūgassa vā piyo manāpo'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho

examples.text: māse māse sahassena, yo yajetha sataṃ samaṃ, ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānaṃ, muhuttam'api pūjaye, sā'y'eva pūjanā seyyo, yañ'ce vassasataṃ hutaṃ.
āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

asevanā ca bālānaṃ, paṇḍitānañ'ca sevanā, pūjā ca pūjanīyānaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

47157.meaning1: worthy of veneration; reverable; deserving honour

māse māse sahassena, yo yajetha sataṃ samaṃ, ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānaṃ, muhuttam'api pūjaye, sā'y'eva pūjanā seyyo, yañ'ce vassasataṃ hutaṃ.

te tādise pūjayato, nibbute akutobhaye, na sakkā puññaṃ saṅkhātuṃ, im'ettam'api kenaci.
tattha devamanussā gandhamāl'ādīhi pūjayamānā, mahāpurisa, idha tumhehi sadiso añño n'atthi, kut'ettha uttaritaro'ti āhaṃsu.

47164.commentary: (DHPa) pūjā parakulesu cā'ti n'eva mātāpitūnaṃ na ñātakānaṃ paresu'y'eva kulesu aho vat'ime mayham'eva dadeyyuṃ, na aññesan'ti evaṃ catuppaccayehi pūjaṃ icchati.

examples.text: asantaṃ bhāvanam'iccheyya, purekkhārañ'ca bhikkhusu, āvāsesu ca issariyaṃ, pūjā parakulesu ca.

ayaṃ pupphapūjā buddha-paccekabuddha-aggasāvaka-mahāsāvaka-arahant'ādīnaṃ sabhāvasīlaṃ. aham'pi tesaṃ anuvattako homi.

47166.meaning1: worthy of veneration; worthy of reverence

examples.text: pūj'ārahe pūjayato, buddhe yadi va sāvake, papañcasamatikkante, tiṇṇasokapariddave.

47169.meaning1: what has been offered is enough; the offering is sufficient

47177.commentary: (ANa) āsan'odakena paṭipūjessāmā'ti āsanena ca pādadhovana-udakena ca pūjayissāma. ettha ca mātāpitūnaṃ devasikaṃ sakkāro kātabbo. samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ pana abbhāgatānaṃ āsanaṃ datvā pādadhovanañ'ca dātabbaṃ, sakkāro ca kātabbo.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, kumāriyo, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, ye te bhattu garuno bhavissanti mātā'ti vā pitā'ti vā samaṇabrāhmaṇā'ti vā, te sakkarissāma garuṃ karissāma mānessāma pūjessāma abbhāgate ca āsan'odakena paṭipūjessāmā'ti. evañ'hi vo, kumāriyo, sikkhitabbaṃ.

47180.meaning1: having revered; having honoured; having respected

examples.text: imañ'ca hi te bhonto na sakkareyyuṃ na garuṃ kareyyuṃ na māneyyuṃ na pūjeyyuṃ, atha kiñ'carahi te bhonto sakkareyyuṃ garuṃ kareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā mānetvā pūjetvā upanissāya vihareyyun'ti?

vassasat'ūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadah'upasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
tam'ahaṃ upasaṅkamma, saraṇaṃ gantvāna satthuno, sambuddhappamukhaṃ saṅghaṃ, gandhamālena pūjayiṃ, pūjetvā gandhamālena, gavapānena tappayiṃ.
yo ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammaṃ'y'eva sakkaronto, dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto, dhammaṃ mānento, dhammaṃ pūjento, dhammaṃ apacāyamāno suvaco hoti, sovacassataṃ āpajjati, tam'ahaṃ suvaco'ti vadāmi.

47183.meaning1: making a devotional offering (to somebody with)

examples.text: iti kho, bhāradvāja, udako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne maṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi
iti kho, bhāradvāja, udako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne maṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi

47186.meaning1: fermented; foul-smelling; fetid; stinking; rotten; putrid
47186.commentary: (DNa) pūtīnī'ti abbhokāse ṭhitāni vāt'ātapavuṭṭhisamphassena terovassikān'eva pūtīni honti, antobhūmigatāni pana cirataraṃ tiṭṭhanti.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ te pūtimuttabhesajjaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa
pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggena, yo naro upanayhati, kusā'pi pūti vāyanti, evaṃ bāl'ūpasevanā.
tāni pāvusakena meghena abhippavuṭṭhāni appakasiren'eva paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti.

47188.meaning1: (of a smell) putrid; rotten; foul; fetid

examples.text: yathā idaṃ tathā etaṃ, yathā etaṃ tathā idaṃ, duggandhaṃ pūtikaṃ vāti, bālānaṃ abhinanditaṃ.

47189.meaning1: more putrid; more rotten; more infected
47189.commentary: (MNa) asucitarāni c'evā'ti-ādīsu pakatiyā'va tāni asucīni ca duggandhāni ca pūtīni ca, idāni pana asucitarāni c'eva duggandhatarāni ca pūtitarāni ca honti.

examples.text: tathā tathā'ssa tāni vaṇamukhāni asucitarāni c'eva honti duggandhatarāni ca pūtikatarāni ca, hoti c'eva kāci sātamattā assādamattā, yadidaṃ vaṇamukhānaṃ kaṇḍūvanahetu.

47190.meaning1: putrid body; disgusting body; stinking body; foul mass

examples.text: alaṃ, vakkali, kiṃ te iminā pūtikāyena diṭṭhena? yo kho, vakkali, dhammaṃ passati so maṃ passati, yo maṃ passati so dhammaṃ passati
evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, iminā pūtikāyena aṭṭīyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi.
tassa pūti-kāyakamm'antassa pūti-vacīkamm'antassa pūti-manokamm'antassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālaṅ'kiriyā.
katamā ca, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni? ye kho te, sāriputta, sattā pūtimacche vā jāyanti pūtikuṇape vā pūtikummāse vā candanikāye vā oḷigalle vā jāyanti, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni.
katamā ca, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni? ye kho te, sāriputta, sattā pūtimacche vā jāyanti pūtikuṇape vā pūtikummāse vā candanikāye vā oḷigalle vā jāyanti, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni.

47197.meaning1: more fetid; more foul-smelling; more rotten

47198.commentary: (SNa) pūtidehasayā'ti pūtimhi mātusarīre vā, attano'y'eva vā sarīraṃ avattharitvā sayanato pūtidehasayā.

examples.text: tañ'hi ete namasseyyuṃ, pūtidehasayā narā, nimuggā kuṇapamh'ete, khuppipāsasamappitā.

47199.commentary: (NPa) pūtibījaṃ'vā'ti pūtibhāvaṃ gataṃ bījaṃ viya. chakaṇa-ras'ādi-paribhāvana-sukkhāpana-sukhasay'ādīni akaraṇena bījadosaduṭṭhan'ti attho.

examples.text: kodhamakkhagaru bhikkhu, lābhasakkāragāravo, sukhette pūtibījaṃ'va, saddhamme na virūhati.
